description: `Phase` declares three variants; the engine supplies state-children for only two. Per §51.0.E E-ENGINE-STATE-CHILD-MISSING fires (§34: Error) — once per uncovered variant. Pins the POSITIVE edge of the engine exhaustiveness guarantee, previously only absence-asserted.
rationale: §51.0.E — an engine is EXHAUSTIVE over its `for=` enum: every variant needs a state-child, or the engine has a reachable state with no UI. This is the engine-tier form of the same guarantee `<match for=T>` enforces at Tier 1 (E-MATCH-NOT-EXHAUSTIVE) — the north-star property that every reachable state has a rendering, checked structurally rather than discovered in production.
